templates.text: Let an event with status {L} change the balances, and keep an event with any other status from changing them.
templates.author: A

templates.text: If an event has status {L}, it takes effect; if it has any other status, it leaves the balances unchanged.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Effect shall be given to each event designated {L}. No effect shall be given to an event designated otherwise.
templates.author: B

templates.text: A status of {L} renders an event operative; any other status renders it inoperative.
templates.author: B

templates.text: Here is the rule: a status of {L} means the event counts, while every other status means it is set aside with no effect on the balances.
templates.author: A

templates.text: When its status is {L}, an event is carried out in full; otherwise, the event is disregarded and no balance changes.
templates.author: C

templates.text: You act on an event when its status reads {L}; for any other status, you do nothing with it.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Any event you come across should be left out of the balances, with one exception: if its status is {L}, apply it.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Unless otherwise provided, an event has no effect. It is hereby provided that an event designated {L} shall take effect.
templates.author: B

templates.text: The balances are, as a rule, unaffected by events; it is only an event whose status is {L} that affects them.
templates.author: B

templates.text: Events are ignored as a rule, but an event whose status is {L} is applied to the balances.
templates.author: C

templates.text: An event normally leaves every balance unchanged. If, however, its status is {L}, the event takes effect.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Events do nothing to the balances, save for those whose status is {L}; these are the events that take effect.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Any event not singled out here has no effect; the ones singled out for posting are those with status {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Keep events off the balances as standard practice, but let through any event that carries status {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: The default is that no event takes effect. By way of exception, an event whose status is {L} does take effect.
templates.author: B

templates.text: An event is, in principle, without effect; an event whose status is {L}, however, alters the balances.
templates.author: B

templates.text: No event changes the balances unless its status is {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Events with status {L} are the only ones that change the balances.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Nothing but events carrying status {L} gets applied.
templates.author: A

templates.text: The capacity to take effect is limited to events whose status is {L}.
templates.author: B

templates.text: An event takes effect solely by virtue of having status {L}.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Events count toward the balances on one condition only: their status is {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Post events with status {L}, and only those.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Whichever events have status {L} stay out of the balances; whichever events have another status go in.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Having status {L} prevents an event from taking effect; having any other status lets it take effect normally.
templates.author: C

templates.text: No balance changes as a result of an event whose status is {L}, but any event with another status takes effect.
templates.author: C

templates.text: It is provided, first, that an event whose status is {L} has no effect and, second, that every other event takes effect.
templates.author: B

templates.text: Rejection without effect is the treatment prescribed for events of status {L}, and acceptance with full effect is the treatment prescribed for all other events.
templates.author: B

templates.text: Ignore any event whose status is {L}. Apply each of the remaining events to the balances.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Events marked {L} are dead entries that change nothing; the rest are live and must be applied.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Events should all be applied to the balances, but any event whose status is {L} should be left out.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Let every event run through the balances, holding back only the events that have status {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Every event changes the balances as usual. Events with status {L}, however, are simply ignored.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Events take effect, but should an event have status {L}, that event leaves the balances unchanged.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Events generally take effect. Make an exception for events marked {L}, and keep those off the balances.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Posting is the default for every event; skipping is reserved for events whose status is {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Each event changes the balances; only when its status is {L} is it prevented from doing so.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Subject to one exception, all events take effect. The exception concerns events whose status is {L}, which have no effect.
templates.author: B

templates.text: All events take effect, those with status {L} excepted; an excepted event leaves every balance as it was.
templates.author: C

templates.text: An event is blocked from taking effect by status {L} and by nothing else.
templates.author: C

templates.text: Apply all but the events whose status is {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: The only events left without effect are those bearing the status {L}.
templates.author: B

templates.text: The giving of effect extends to all events, subject only to the exclusion of those whose status is {L}.
templates.author: B

templates.text: Of all statuses, only {L} disqualifies an event from taking effect.
templates.author: B

templates.text: Barring a status of {L}, an event takes effect.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Events marked {L} are the one group you do not apply.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Nothing keeps an event off the balances except a status of {L}.
templates.author: A

templates.text: Each event is put into effect, barring any event with status {L}.
templates.author: C
